requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个温湿度与风扇联动系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、风扇 PWM 引脚 D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D2。默认显示温度，每按一次按钮切换显示温度或湿度；当温度高于 30℃ 时自动打开风扇并根据温度升高程度提升转速。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_2=false (initial), io_5 rising edge (pressed), keep io_0 and io_1 unchanged
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_4 remains valid selection gate output derived from retained-if-valid logic; with io_2=false, io_4 outputs 0 and io_3 outputs 0.0; showHumidity toggles only on press rising edge

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个温湿度与风扇联动系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、风扇 PWM 引脚 D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D2。默认显示温度，每按一次按钮切换显示温度或湿度；当温度高于 30℃ 时自动打开风扇并根据温度升高程度提升转速。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_2=true, io_0=30.0, io_1 arbitrary, io_5 held false

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个温湿度与风扇联动系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、风扇 PWM 引脚 D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D2。默认显示温度，每按一次按钮切换显示温度或湿度；当温度高于 30℃ 时自动打开风扇并根据温度升高程度提升转速。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_2=true, io_0=35.0, io_1 arbitrary, io_5 held false; then set io_0=40.0 with io_2=true
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_3 increases with temperature: pwmCountFan=floor((io_0-30.0)*25.5); at 35.0 it is between 0 and 255, at 40.0 io_3=255.0; io_4 shows floor(io_0)=35 then 40 when showHumidity=false

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个温湿度与风扇联动系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、风扇 PWM 引脚 D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D2。默认显示温度，每按一次按钮切换显示温度或湿度；当温度高于 30℃ 时自动打开风扇并根据温度升高程度提升转速。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_2=true, io_0=25.0, io_1=55.0; create one press rising edge on io_5 (false->true), then hold io_5 true for another step
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: After rising edge: showHumidity toggles to true so io_4=floor(io_1)=55 while io_3 stays 0.0 (since io_0<=30.0); holding io_5 true does not toggle again
